intro: Salvation came from Flora. Previously only a guess, the boats were now clearly visible. In a quick movement, she managed to grab onto one of them. Ana and Igor followed closely behind, and soon the three of them were in a small boat, fighting the current.
line1: Hold on tight, the waves are getting bigger!
line4: Well, Igor, the man who can get us off this floor of the Tower-In-The-Middle-Of-The-Street!
line5: Seriously, Igor, don't you remember him?
line6: Hahaha, of course, I'm just kidding!
line7: Only you would be making jokes at this point!
line8: Look at him over there, let's try to get there!
end: After much effort, the friends finally made it to the opposite bank, right at the foot of the opulent armchair that only made the puny old man seem even smaller. Still catching their breath, they realized their host was in a deep sleep.
